parameters.query: SELECT p.id AS project_id, p.title, s.id AS scene_id, s.scene_number, s.title AS scene_title, s.summary, s.characters_present, s.location, s.time_period, s.emotional_tone, s.chapter_id, c.chapter_number FROM projects p JOIN scenes s ON p.id = s.project_id JOIN chapters c ON s.chapter_id = c.id WHERE p.id = $1 AND p.state = 'worldbuilt' ORDER BY c.chapter_number, s.scene_number
UPDATE bibles SET content = jsonb_set(content, '{timeline_validation}', $2::jsonb), updated_at = NOW() WHERE project_id = $1 AND bible_type = 'timeline'
UPDATE projects SET state = 'timeline_verified', timeline_validation_result = $2::jsonb, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1
INSERT INTO events (project_id, event_type, payload, created_at) VALUES ($1, 'timeline_verified', $2::jsonb, NOW())
